title: Container logs
description: One logs panel, parameterised by a raw Loki label matcher. Exists to be embedded via /d-solo — daedalus frames it wherever a page needs the log lines for one service, without the Drilldown app's label pickers, datasource selector and histogram coming along for the ride. The variable holds the whole matcher (container="factorio", stack="lemonade") rather than a container name, because the one service whose logs did not come from this box's journal — Lemonade, pushed in over the WebSocket bridge in stacks/lemonade-logs — has no container label to be selected by.
